from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import Optional

class SurplusReserveRecord(BaseModel):
    """Extracted surplus reserve data from a single company's financial report."""
    company_name: str = Field(description="Name of the company, e.g., '惠州亿纬锂能'")
    report_period: str = Field(description="The financial report period, e.g., '2024年第一季度'")
    line_item_name: str = Field(description="The exact accounting line item name used in the report, e.g., '盈余公积' or '法定盈余公积'")
    amount: float = Field(description="The numeric amount of the reserve found in the report")
    currency_unit: str = Field(description="The currency unit, e.g., '元'")
    distinction_note: Optional[str] = Field(description="Any note regarding whether statutory reserve is distinguished from arbitrary reserve")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    surplus_reserve_records: list[SurplusReserveRecord]
